claim: Exact GPU comparison and cached CPU certificates reduce repeated validation cost for unchanged or lightly changed output, but every-block changes and initial certification cost more. Sparse diagnostics have reduced coverage.
audience: Mike, Fadi and Joel reviewing Aureon validation performance

metric.name: Synchronous validation time; separate figure for placement plus validation
metric.aggregation: median with every raw trial; one initial-certification observation explicitly n=1
metric.denominator: 100 million markers / 300 million coordinates; sparse mode samples65536markers

uncertainty.note: Ten raw repetitions per steady-state case; initial setup/certification each observed once. No confidence intervals.

data_source.notes: Only selected publication run is used; source/binary hashes captured before execution by benchmark runner. Every prior raw result retained separately. Changed-output cases ran after unchanged comparison; raw timing spread shown, no claim small changes are faster than unchanged output.

cost_latency_assumptions.other: 18CPUworkers; resident packedXYZ output. FullGPU mode reads every output bit and applies unchanged FP64CPUvalidator to changed4096-marker blocks. Sparse fixed reused sample plan checks0.065536% ofmarkers.

exceptions: First-certification point has n=1 and no median diamond; separately observed context setup is captioned from source.
Companion figure separates sparse mode by horizontal rule and explicit reduced-coverage labels.
